title: Fraud Detection and Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A hackathon project combining a Random Forest fraud-detection model with synthetic transaction data generation for testing and model development. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit real transaction data and generate synthetic datasets for privacy-preserving model training and testing.
